privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What this site collects, what for, and how long it is kept.
paragraphs: The short version: you do not need to give us anything to read this site. If you create an account, we keep your email and nothing beyond that. We do not use third-party cookies and we do not follow you across other pages.

sections.heading: What we do not do
paragraphs: You do not need an account to browse the site, and browsing asks for nothing. There are no contact forms and no newsletter, and the site never asks for your phone or your payment details.
Payments are not processed on the site: you make the transfer from your bank, and that operation is between your bank and ours.
We do not use advertising cookies, social-media pixels or services that build a profile of you.

sections.heading: If you create an account
paragraphs: Creating an account is optional and serves one purpose: to be able to say "I am bringing this one" and have it written down as yours.

From you we keep your email and, only if you write them down, the name you want shown and the language you prefer to be written in. Your password is not kept: what is kept is an encrypted result that cannot be turned back into your password.
The name shown is the one you choose, and it is never derived from your email. If you write none, there is none.
Your email is not published on any page, is not shared with anyone, and is not used to send you anything other than messages about your account or about something you offered to bring.

The service that runs the accounts also records when you sign in, with the IP address and the browser you sign in from. It is there to detect attempts to get into other people's accounts. The family does not use that information for anything else.
Your account is kept until you delete it. You can delete it yourself from your account, without asking us and without giving reasons: your email and your name are deleted right away.

sections.heading: What is measured
paragraphs: We count visits and a few use events: how many people come, from what kind of link they arrive, how many times a bank detail is copied, how many times the page is shared and from which country it is opened.
Those measurements are aggregated and cannot be tied to a person. We do not keep your full IP address, or an identifier that follows you between visits.
They serve one thing: to know whether the page is understood and whether the path to help works.

sections.heading: Gifts
paragraphs: If you give by transfer, your bank tells ours the details of the operation. That information stays in the internal accounting record and is used to reconcile the totals.
The name of the person who gave and the individual amount are not published.
The internal record is kept while the campaign is open and for as long as the accounting requires.

sections.heading: Expense receipts
paragraphs: Invoices and receipts for the work are stored in private storage. They are not public because they often hold third-party data, such as a supplier's name and address.
The file can be reviewed by a person with an auditor role, with a temporary access.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the date in the heading changes and the change is recorded in the public history of the site's code.
For questions about this policy, the published email is justomiguelvargas@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.lead: What this site is, what it is not, and what you can expect from it.
paragraphs: This site belongs to Norma's family and exists to raise the funds to rebuild their house and to account for how they are used.

sections.heading: What a gift is
paragraphs: A gift is a voluntary donation to a family. It is not a purchase, it does not entitle you to anything in return, and it is not tax-deductible: the project is not an entity with legal personality.
Gifts are not returned, except for a transfer error that can be shown with the bank receipt.

sections.heading: What the money is used for
paragraphs: On the work on the house: materials, labour, services, tools and transport. Each expense is published on the transparency page with its date, its description and its category.
If money is ever left over from the work, the destination will be published before it is used.

sections.heading: Accuracy of the information
paragraphs: The published figures are updated after reconciliation with the bank, so they may be a few days behind reality. The date of the last reconciliation is always visible.
When a fact has not yet been verified, the section is omitted. This site does not show sample amounts, dates or bank details.

sections.heading: Beware of fake sites
paragraphs: Always check the address of the site before you transfer. If the bank details you see do not match the ones we share on our channels, do not transfer.
We will never ask you for a password, a code from your bank or your card details.

sections.heading: Content
paragraphs: The texts and photographs on the site belong to the family. They may be shared to spread the campaign; they may not be used for commercial purposes.
